response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished senior full-stack/web engineer with some low-latency backend experience, but the role requires deep hardware expertise in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator performance analysis, and hardware-software co-design. The resume shows no experience with computer architecture, GPU/SIMD/MIMD systems, deep-learning workload optimization, or silicon design — the core competencies of this principal-level position.
strengths: Strong low-latency systems experience (DLang, async I/O, fibers) handling millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby
Long, consistent track record (~18 years) across web, mobile, embedded, and backend systems
Some C/C++ and hardware-adjacent work (National Instruments tooling, robotic arms, audio/wave field synthesis thesis)
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, computer architecture, or hardware-software co-design experience
No AI/deep-learning training or inference workload background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack, far from principal-level performance architecture for AI accelerators

key_factors.factor: No AI/DL workload or GPU experience
